description: The Republic of Ireland's Health Service Executive (HSE) has approved tucatinib in combination with trastuzumab and capecitabine for reimbursement as a treatment option for the treatment of adult patients with HER2-positive locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer who have received at least two prior anti-HER2 treatment regimens.

contributions.description: Initial curation of this indication into moalmanac-db. Availability within the public health system confirmed by personal correspondence with the NCCP on 2026-11-03.
